licences.title: Licences
licences.description: Signed licence files for customers who run Ziira on their own servers.
licences.help: A licence is a signed file you give to a customer who hosts Ziira themselves. It says which units they may use, how many users, branches and companies, and until when. It is signed with the vendor's key, which lives only on the vendor's server: a copy that is not the vendor's deployment cannot issue licences. Revoked licences are listed in a signed revocation file you install on their copy.
licences.revokeMessage: The licence stops being valid once the customer installs the new revocation list. This cannot be undone.
licences.keyNote: The licence is signed with this server's signing key. If the server has none, it tells you so here.
licences.issuedHint: Give this file to {{customer}}. It can be downloaded again from the list.

basisHints.plan: The plan's units and limits are the starting point.

licences.graceHint: How long it keeps working after it expires.
licences.instanceHint: Optional. Ties the licence to one installation.
licences.emptyHint: Issue one for a customer who hosts Ziira on their own server.
